items.title: Meta Slashes Smart Glasses by 25% for Black Friday, Including Ray-Ban & Oakley Frames
items.summary:
Meta is knocking off a good chunk of change from its smart glasses this Black Friday, with savings of up to 25% on select models. From now until November 30th, the Ray-Ban Meta Gen 2 and Oakley Meta HSTN are 25% off, while select Meta Glasses and Oakley Meta Vanguard models are discounted by 15%. […]
